membership context

  • CURIE: gmeow:membershipContext
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/membershipContext
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/music

An optional context or standpoint that scopes this membership — e.g. an ascent/descent passage, a theoretical tradition, or an analytical framework. Non-functional: a membership may be asserted in multiple contexts.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:PitchCollectionMembership -> gmeow:Entity

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:membershipContext from gmeow:PitchCollectionMembership to gmeow:Entity when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:PitchCollectionMembership, gmeow:Entity
